category: The operating system for agent organizations
headline: Delegate outcomes, not every next step.
body: Ateles gives role-specific agents an organization to work within: named relationships, explicit authority, high-level context, coordinated execution, and checkpoints only when a decision genuinely needs you. That is robust organizational design for agents.
footnote: Open source · single-operator reference implementation today · multi-operator design ahead
scope: one swarm · distinct roles · shared mission
